title: Q-BLINDSPOT-SELF-HSTS: ultrastable.io sends no Strict-Transport-Security header
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** GET https://blindspot.ultrastable.app/api/check?domain=ultrastable.io reports hsts pass
**Status:** open

Found by the first spun-off app run on its own platform (SPINOFF-1, 2026-11-17). Add the header in site/worker.js responses.

size: S

**Closing probe:** GET https://blindspot.ultrastable.app/api/check?domain=ultrastable.io expect "pass":true for id hsts
